test_set.english: Fetch the logs and rotate the keys; these may run concurrently, in any order.
test_set.ainglish: Fetch the logs; rotate the keys, in-parallel.

test_set.english: Build the image and run the linter; neither needs to wait for the other.
test_set.ainglish: Build the image; run the linter, in-parallel.

test_set.english: Drain the queue, then take the backup; each step must finish before the next starts.
test_set.ainglish: Drain the queue; take the backup, in-sequence.

test_set.english: Stop the workers and snapshot the disk; do these one after another, strictly in order.
test_set.ainglish: Stop the workers; snapshot the disk, in-sequence.

test_set.english: Warm the cache and prefetch the models; both may overlap freely.
test_set.ainglish: Warm the cache; prefetch the models, in-parallel.

test_set.english: Apply the migration, then clear the cache; the second must wait for the first.
test_set.ainglish: Apply the migration; clear the cache, in-sequence.
